description: The 4StoreyBuilding model is open in eQUEST. This is a 4-storey commercial office building. Your task is to model a building envelope air sealing retrofit. You must reduce the infiltration rate (AIR-CHANGES/HR) for ALL Perimeter Spaces on all four floors (Ground, 2nd, 3rd, Top) to 0.25 ACH. There are 4 perimeter spaces per floor (South, East, North, West), totaling 16 spaces. DO NOT modify the infiltration rate of the Core (interior) spaces. After making the changes, run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation and save the project.
